original.target_description: Original full primary paper not acquired within the per-paper acquisition budget.

replication.target_description: Okobia et al. (2011), Table I: overall prostate cancer in Afro-Caribbean Tobago men; rs1447295 A-carriers (C/A + A/A) versus C/C, logistic regression. The replication sample is Tobago, distinct from each original population.

n.sample_role: Successfully genotyped prostate cancer cases and controls included in the overall rs1447295 genotype analysis.
n.exclusions: Excluded prior prostate cancer at enrollment; elevated PSA/abnormal DRE without biopsy or with normal biopsy; limited to men reporting three or four African-descent grandparents. SNP-specific genotyping completeness determines included counts.
n.location: Results, Association of Chromosome 8q24 SNP rs1447295 (Region 1); Table I rs1447295 column headers
n.quote: The genotyping assays for chromosome 8q24 SNP rs1447295 were successful in 354 cases and 438 controls.

es.location: Table I, rs1447295 (C/A) + (A/A) row, OR column

p.location: Table I, rs1447295 (C/A) + (A/A) row, P-value column

reported_success.location: Discussion, paragraph beginning “Allele A of rs1447295”
reported_success.quote: Allele A of rs1447295 was not associated with risk of prostate cancer in Tobago men.

notes: Original target: European Americans. Original DOI 10.1038/ng1808 could not be acquired as full text; closed publisher preview, no Unpaywall/OpenAlex OA copy, repository routes unavailable or metadata-only. No original statistic was substituted from secondary reporting. Replication Table I prints genotype-carrier OR, not a per-allele OR; the supplied allele-A description does not specify an inheritance model, so the overall A-carrier comparison is used and explicitly identified. All four assigned records point to this same replication Table I contrast; this is one replication sample, not four independent samples. The replication authors' SNP-specific narrative verdict is used rather than their paper-wide conclusion about other 8q24 variants.
